scientific_question: Did v187.1 fail because its DCT12 detector-potential modes were pooled across cameras, or because retaining only the 143 non-DC DCT12 modes per camera was itself insufficient?
role: post-open mechanism-attribution diagnostic on exactly the same four already-open p=22kw_size=01 frames; it is not predictor training, a complete-trajectory gate, a resource benchmark, fresh generalization, or real BOST
physical_hypothesis: For each fixed reported geometry, retaining the frozen DCT12 modes separately for each active camera preserves camera-specific detector-potential phase that the v187.1 Plucker-weighted sum can cancel. A fixed-threshold setup-local Moore-Penrose inverse then measures the remaining camera-resolved DCT12 capacity without a shared cross-geometry model.
physical_distinction: v188 keeps the v186.1 potential integration, DCT12 truncation, affine field basis, p22 frames, reported geometries, five/all-nine sensor arms, K0/K1 refinement, metrics, gates, and threshold unchanged. Its only scientific change from v187.1 is to concatenate each active camera's 143 non-DC DCT12 coefficients in sorted canonical camera-ID order instead of multiplying by reported-ray descriptors and summing across cameras. It adds no descriptor, ridge, damping, fallback, search, or learned parameter.

data_isolation.fit_source: reuse only the sealed v186.1 affine center and 1009-row basis; rebuild the 26 response matrices from frozen reported geometry and forward operators because the parent did not retain camera-resolved DCT arrays
data_isolation.heldout_source: the same already-open p=22kw_size=01 frame indices 0,25,75,100 used by v185-v187; build deployment-visible observations and detector potentials through the frozen forward and potential integration
heldout_truth_forbidden_from: camera roster, DCT coefficients, response matrices, SVD threshold, retained rank, coordinates, K0 field, K1 step size, fallback, and stopping
any descriptor, regularizer, candidate, threshold, or decision choice
heldout_truth_allowed_only_for: synthetic observations through the frozen forward operator
final field and gradient scoring after observation-only K0 candidates are sealed

primary.name: camera_resolved_dct12_setup_local_pseudoinverse
primary.per_camera_transform: place each camera's zero-mean scalar detector potential on its frozen detector grid, apply orthonormal type-II 2D DCT, take the leading 12x12 square in C order, and remove its DC coefficient
primary.camera_order: sort active canonical camera IDs numerically and concatenate their 143-mode rows; input camera iteration order cannot change the feature
primary.reported_geometry_use: reported geometry determines the active canonical camera IDs, vector/scalar ray operators, valid detector rows, and detector grid only; no Plucker or other camera descriptor is appended
primary.formal_inverse: thin scipy.linalg.svd of H with LAPACK gesdd; retain singular values s_i >= s_0*sqrt(float64 epsilon); apply the Moore-Penrose inverse for either tall or wide H
primary.independent_inverse: thin scipy.linalg.svd of independently rebuilt H with LAPACK gesvd and the identical threshold
primary.coordinate: for H=U diag(s) V^T and observation feature f, a=(f V_r / s_r) U_r^T; for five cameras this selects the minimum-norm affine coordinate in the retained 715-dimensional left subspace

blocking_references.v187_1_pooled_geometry_local: independently validated negative pooled DCT12 plus Plucker setup-local K0/K1 result; no retuning
blocking_references.v186_1_shared_linear: independently validated negative shared-linear result; no retuning
blocking_references.v185_dense_camera_resolved_potential: independently validated positive dense-potential K1 capacity result; upper information reference

evaluation.physical_k1_rule: one unmodified identity-preconditioned physical CGLS step from the supplied field using the exact current residual and denominator floor 1e-30
evaluation.subset_rule: reuse the immutable minimal_shared_gram_ridge five-camera subset frozen before p22 truth was opened

cost_ledger.geometry_cache: 26 dense camera-resolved response matrices, scalar-potential setup integration, and setup-local SVD factors are offline diagnostic costs and must be reported separately
cost_ledger.resource_claim: none before a separately frozen compact predictor, complete-trajectory matched accuracy, fresh-process wall, and whole-pipeline RSS

required_validity_gates: v185, v186.1, and v187.1 bound decisions and sealed trees remain unchanged
all 26 response matrices and 104 heldout feature rows are rebuilt without heldout scoring truth entering the feature or inverse API
five-camera features have exactly 715 finite values and all-nine features exactly 1287 finite values
each active camera contributes exactly 143 modes in sorted canonical camera-ID order and every detector potential remains zero mean within tolerance 1e-10
the formal and independent response matrices agree within relative tolerance 1e-8 despite separate feature and SVD implementations
each fixed-threshold SVD retains at least one finite positive singular value and reports rank, condition, reconstruction residual, stationarity, and retained-left-subspace coordinate fraction
the prediction API accepts no truth, trajectory, time, power, or size input
fixed-observation truth mutation leaves coordinates and K0 candidates byte-identical
reversing input camera iteration order leaves canonical features, response matrices, coordinates, and K0 fields unchanged within 1e-10
K0/K1 candidates, metrics, and exact-call arrays are finite and match the frozen shapes
physical K1 has no denominator breakdown
formal and all parent input trees remain unchanged
the independent second implementation passes every required comparison

must_independently_rebuild: all scalar detector potentials and camera-resolved DCT12 feature rows using an independent camera loop and DCT call
all 26 response matrices, gesvd pseudoinverses, ranks, conditions, coordinates, reconstruction residuals, and stationarity
p22 fields, calibrations, frozen five-camera selections, exact vector operators, K0 fields, unchanged physical K1 fields, metrics, tails, decisions, and call receipts

decision_order: Any parent, identity, isolation, shape, DCT, camera-order, SVD, rank, stationarity, mutation, K1, call-ledger, finite, seal, or independent-recomputation failure makes v188 inconclusive.

If K0 passes both sensor arms, conclude PASS_CAMERA_RESOLVED_DCT12_K0_CAPACITY_V188: cross-camera pooling is the supported v187.1 bottleneck and camera-resolved DCT12 is sufficient before refinement under this post-open gate.
If K0 fails but K1 passes both sensor arms, conclude PASS_CAMERA_RESOLVED_DCT12_K1_CAPACITY_V188: cross-camera pooling is the supported v187.1 bottleneck after preserving one physical K1 step.

If all-nine K1 passes but five-camera K1 fails, conclude PARTIAL_CAMERA_POOLING_BOTTLENECK_FIVE_CAMERA_DCT12_GAP_V188: removing pooling rescues all-nine, while the five-camera DCT12 truncation remains insufficient relative to the positive dense v185 reference.

If five-camera K1 passes but all-nine K1 fails, conclude PARTIAL_FIVE_CAMERA_PASS_ALL_NINE_DCT12_GAP_V188: pooling is not the sole failure mechanism and the all-nine camera-resolved DCT12 inverse remains inadequate.
If neither sensor arm passes K1, conclude FAIL_CAMERA_RESOLVED_DCT12_CAPACITY_V188: camera-resolved DCT12 remains insufficient beyond pooling under the frozen setup-local inverse.
A passing or partial v188 result changes only the representation-attribution judgment. It does not authorize neural training, deployment, resource claims, an untouched external gate, or real BOST.
No v188 outcome proves mathematical impossibility or supports first, SOTA, global uniqueness, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
